vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 404-page-generator
Version: 1.0.0

The skill bundle provides standard UX and design guidelines for generating and optimizing 404 error pages. It contains no executable code, network requests, or suspicious instructions, and its behavior is entirely consistent with its stated purpose in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only helper for creating and auditing 404 pages; its instructions, required resources, and privileges match its stated purpose and it does not request credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (404 page design, optimization, audit) match the SKILL.md content. The guidance covers UX, navigation, copy, technical checks, and conversion opportunities — all appropriate for the stated purpose. There are no unrelated dependencies, binaries, or credentials required.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to 404 page guidance. They ask the agent to read .claude/project-context.md or .cursor/project-context.md if present to obtain brand voice and page context — this is reasonable for producing site-specific copy/design suggestions. Note: reading those workspace files gives the skill access to any content stored there, so users should ensure those files do not contain secrets or sensitive data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — the skill is instruction-only, so it does not download or install external code. This is the lowest-risk install profile.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. Its requests are proportional to its functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no indications the skill modifies other skills or system settings. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) but not combined with elevated privileges or credential access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent and low-risk: it provides guidance for 404 pages and only asks the agent to read specific project-context files if they exist. Before installing, confirm that any .claude/project-context.md or .cursor/project-context.md files in your workspace do not contain private secrets or credentials (they should only contain brand voice and public site info). Because it's an instruction-only skill, it won't install code, but note the agent can be invoked autonomously by default — if you prefer manual control, ensure your agent settings limit automatic skill use.
